240-5470-7175-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-4550-5042-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
728-4550-5042-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

413-851-4559-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
413-851-4559-7839.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1263-1417-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-5961--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Repeat.

2173-2324-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

757-4235-7014.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on it and skipping your next turn.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

2577-5256-7390.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1558-3756-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1308-4659-5346-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2557-3899-4552-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1987-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1309-1987-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2438-5220-7192.description:
Cast Carrion Feeder by paying its mana cost.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1115-2203-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1115-2203-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-3007-3899-4552.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-851-3007-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4268-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4268-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

315-4465-5243--138.description:
Activate the Sliver that can be cast using {B}{B} by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
The Sliver is put onto the top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to the replacement effect given to it by Pulmonic Sliver.
Cast the Sliver from the top of your library by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2478-2866-2921-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2459-3967-5220-5683.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Rograkh and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1429-4050-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4050-5958.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding one mana of any color.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Repeat.

1115-2933-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

2438-2730-3719-5131.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn if Ruthless Technomancer is in your graveyard.
2438-2730-3719-5131.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer either from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

2054-2232-2440-3433.description:
Cast Hornet Queen by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Hornet Queen enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio, and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Hornet Queen trigger, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
When the Insects enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Cloudstone Curio each trigger four times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Hornet Queen from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {5} for each Insect you control.
Activate Urn of Godfire's first ability three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1192-2452-5113-5220.description:
Cast Overcharged Amalgam either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Overcharged Amalgam enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Overcharged Amalgam dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3176-3903.description:
Whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, Knowledge Pool triggers, exiling that spell.
Because Archon of Emeria prevents players from casting more than one spell each turn, players cannot cast the spell permitted by Knowledge Pool, or any other spell that turn.

65-717-2628-5044-5181.description:
Activate Raffine's Tower's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Raffine's Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Raffine's Tower ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

760-3139-3575.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrificing itself.
Aerie Ouphes' persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Aerie Ouphes enters the battlefield, triggering The Great Henge, putting one +1/+1 counter on Aerie Ouphes and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aerie Ouphes ability, dealing damage equal to its power to Swans of Bryn Argoll, causing you to draw cards equal to the damage prevented this way.
Repeat.

632-2178-4050-5004.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Scarecrone.
Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-2178-4050-5004.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {1}.
Cathodion dies, triggering itself and Scarecrone.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Scarecrone trigger, untapping it.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

930-2034-2232-2983.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, triggering Sethron, creating a 2/2 Minotaur creature token.
The Minotaur enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Universal Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Minotaur token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2181-4944.description:
Activate Frenetic Sliver's ability.
Crackdown Construct gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
With the ability on the stack, repeat.
